message.title: PitLog v1.5.25 Released 🚀
message.body:
PitLog v1.5.25 Released 🚀
2026-05-07
A focused update with improvements to the Prop Firm Tracker, Trade Log, and the overall experience:

Prop Firm (Rithmic): Live Threshold is now read directly from your Trader Dashboard CSV — real value from your prop firm, not a simulation
Prop Firm (Rithmic): buffer remaining is shown on the card (e.g. "$941 left") and updates with each import
Prop Firm (Rithmic): a timestamp shows when the threshold was last imported
Rithmic import: now requires two CSVs (Positions + Trader Dashboard) — commission is calculated automatically, no manual entry
Rithmic parser: multi-section files now import correctly; Cancelled/Rejected orders are skipped automatically
Rithmic parser: partial fill FIFO fix — remaining lots are kept in the queue with proportional commission
Trade Log: bulk delete — select one or more trades and remove them all at once
UI: all text is now in English throughout the app

🔗 Use the download link from your original Payhip purchase email to get the latest version.
